representation: Same SOURCE convex hull geometry as the 3D display; reference uses the reference pose, not the unknown exact physics collision body.
zero_distance_meaning: Touching and overlapping both have zero minimum separation. Contact boolean uses the original convex feasibility rule, with no added margin.
fallback_policy: An active experiment without a record for one car uses the filtered candidate pose explicitly. Explicit unknown stays unknown. No method records at the frame means use the selected baseline and label that fallback.
